description: This file defines classes and methods for integrating project task work with timesheet entries in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including handling user-related details, creation, updating, and deletion of timesheet records linked to project tasks.

classes.name: project_work
classes.description: Extends project.task.work to handle timesheet integration, including creation, update, and deletion of related timesheet entries.

classes.name: task
classes.description: Extends project.task to manage linked timesheet entries during task updates and deletions.

classes.name: project_project
classes.description: Extends project.project to customize display name with category code.

methods.name: get_user_related_details
methods.description: Retrieves product, journal, account, and UOM details related to a user for timesheet entries, raising configuration errors if missing.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a timesheet entry linked to a project task, calculating amounts based on product price and hours.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Updates linked timesheet entries when a project task work record is modified.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Deletes linked timesheet entries when a project task work record or task is deleted.

methods.name: name_get
methods.description: Returns formatted project name including category code for display.
